title: Function card
responsibility: Shows a linked function invocation with revision-owned sample arguments instead of a heading or description.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The function at the viewed revision, including its symbols, input contract and committed usage examples.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation that keeps the selected branch and commit when opening the function.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: One clickable invocation opening that selected callable’s Contract page in the same branch and revision; no separate arrow, title or description.
